name: linear-micro-crm
description: Linear Micro CRM — field sales gauges, recruitment pipeline and finance in one platform.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.restart: npm run stop -w server; npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w server
